title: Helping a friend’s New Year project
instructions: Write in English in connected paragraphs. Complete all the requested points. Task 1 requires at least 150 words. This is letter preparation, not a full IELTS Writing test.

stimulus.text:
Task 1
Your English-speaking friend Amir is preparing a college project about New Year celebrations in different countries. He has asked you to help. Write a letter to Amir. In your letter:
• explain how important New Year is to people in your country
• describe how people celebrate it
• explain what you personally enjoy about these celebrations.
Begin your letter: Dear Amir,
Write at least 150 words in connected paragraphs. You do not need to write any addresses. Aim to spend about 20 minutes. Use a personal style.

questions.prompt: Write your letter. Develop every part of all three bullet points and write at least 150 words.

criteria.label: Task achievement — Task 1
criteria.description: For Task 1 only: clear letter purpose, appropriate personal relationship and register, and sufficiently developed, relevant coverage of every component in the three bullet points. Do not replace the requested function with a related but different one; at least 150 words.

criteria.label: Coherence and cohesion
criteria.description: Assess logical progression, purposeful paragraphs and clear referencing/linking within each response; avoid mechanical connector counts.

criteria.label: Lexical resource
criteria.description: Assess accurate, appropriate vocabulary and collocation, flexibility of expression and the effect of spelling or word-formation errors in each response.

criteria.label: Grammatical range and accuracy
criteria.description: Assess control of simple and complex structures, sentence boundaries and punctuation, with attention to errors that obscure meaning in each response.

assessment.feedbackGuidance: After submission only: Private annotated snippets, after submission only: “For many families, New Year is an important chance to spend time together.” explains importance without making an absolute claim about everyone. “We usually visit relatives during the holiday.” describes a custom with a frequency qualifier. “I especially enjoy these visits because we have time to talk without rushing.” adds a personal preference and reason instead of repeating the custom. These are illustrative possibilities, not required claims about a culture; accept the learner’s relevant accurate account. Map all three bullet functions to actual learner spans and identify any missing component. Separate missing content from vague development or inappropriate register. Explain one useful paragraphing choice, one lexical choice and one grammar issue with evidence; ask the learner to revise an underdeveloped point and an unclear sentence, then explain the revisions. Do not require these exemplar details, memorised text, real contact details or a fixed greeting/closing formula beyond the task. No band, score, calibrated estimate or official examiner claim.

locale.instructionsFa: به انگلیسی و در بندهای پیوسته بنویسید. همهٔ موارد نامه را پاسخ دهید و دست‌کم ۱۵۰ واژه بنویسید. این تمرین نامه‌نویسی است و آزمون کامل نیست.
locale.feedbackGuidanceFa: پس از ثبت پاسخ، برای هر جزء خواسته‌شده یک شاهد از نوشته بیابید. نبود محتوا، توضیح ناکافی و لحن نامناسب را جدا بررسی کنید. یک دلیل را به پیامد مرتبط کنید و یک عبارت زمانی یا جمله را اصلاح کنید. بازخورد، نمره یا برآورد معتبر آیلتس نیست.
